entities.name: Jean Marie du Lau
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Marie du Lau was a French Catholic prelate who served as the last Archbishop of Arles. He was one of the Catholic Martyrs of September 1792, killed in the September Massacres during the French Revolution. He was beatified on 17 October 1926 by Pope Pius XI.
